manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the green bottle with white label from the table head-up.

Task description: Pick up the green bottle with a white label lying horizontally on the table and turn it mouth-up. Its mouth currently points right in the image and its bottom left. Use the left arm to move it into the airborne area to the robot's left.

Success criteria: Lift the bottle with its opening facing upward and move it to the area on the robot’s left, away from the center of the table. Raise it clearly above the table to the holding height in front of the left arm.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the straight bottle body near the white label, avoiding the tapering shoulder and raised base. Orient the gripper’s closing direction as close to perpendicular to the bottle’s long axis as possible to reduce slipping.
- When approaching from above, leave clearance between fingertips and tabletop. Use overhead and wrist views to confirm that the selected section of the bottle body is between both pads before closing.
- After closing, first make a small lift to confirm the bottle moves with the gripper. Raise it high enough to leave room for the base to rotate, then gradually turn the opening upward, avoiding contact between the base and table.
